lines.text: Many learners say: I want that you come tomorrow.
Better: I want you to come tomorrow.
To be! I want her to be here.

data.wrong: I want that you come tomorrow.
data.right: I want you to come tomorrow.

native.tip: En français, « je veux que vous veniez ». En anglais, pas de “that” : “want you to”.
native.caption: Vous dites “I want that you come tomorrow.” ? Pas de “that” ! Dites plutôt “I want you to come tomorrow.” — écoutez Carlos et répétez avec lui ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.
native.comment: Réponse : “to be” — Pas de “that” après “want” : on dit “want someone to”. Testez d’autres pièges avec un quiz gratuit : {link}

en.tip: In English, no “that” after “want”: say “want you to”.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I want that you come tomorrow.” No “that”! Say “I want you to come tomorrow.” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
